lines.en: I waddle along
My flippers swing back and forth

lines.zh: 我踩在雪上，留下三趾印
lines.en: I leave three-toed prints in the snow
I slip every few steps and hit the ice
I walk at the back of the line
I waddle to the edge of the ice
I look down at my feet

lines.zh: 我的肚子贴着雪滑了一段
lines.en: I slide a stretch on my belly
I turn a corner on the ice

lines.zh: 我和前面的同伴撞了一下
lines.en: I bump into the one ahead
I stop to groom a feather
I hop down off a snow drift
I call as I walk
My head turns side to side
I head for the sea
I stop at the mouth of an ice hole
I go around a floe
I move quickly, though I sway
I stand with my chest out
I tuck my head a little
Wind ruffles my feathers
I preen a wing with my beak
I watch the water far out

lines.zh: 雪落在我背上，我抖了抖
lines.en: Snow lands on my back; I shake it off
I lift a flipper and fold it back
I call twice and no one answers
The sun is low and the ice is bright
I shift my weight
I wait for a gust to pass
My belly is full
This stone is warmer than snow
I half-close my eyes
You walk very strangely
I turn my head sideways at you

lines.zh: 你身上一根羽毛也没有
lines.en: There's not a feather on you
You stand like a fence post
I don't mind you here
What's that on your feet
I'll call once; listen
Step back and I'll come forward
Crouching helps
Neither of us likes being stared at
I shriek and back away
I fall on the ice and slide

lines.zh: 我全身羽毛一下全炸开
lines.en: Every feather puffs out at once
I flap my flippers to keep balance
I limp away
I flap my two stubby flippers
My calls come faster now
I pull my neck in
I've backed off, but I'm not running
I look at the wound
Is that thing a fish
I smell the sea
Lower the fish a bit
I'm coming over; hold still
That's enough for a bite
I won't snatch; I'll wait
It's moving; still alive
Your hands smell of fish
Just one more
I've got it; thank you
You bump me and I slide
I hit your leg and step back

lines.zh: 我和同伴挤了一下，差点滑倒。
lines.en: My mate and I bump and nearly slip.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的鞋印，站稳了。
lines.en: I plant my feet on your footprint and hold.
I press against your boot
I knock over a little snow
You knock me sliding
I steady myself and go on
We squeeze through the ice gap
I move to the side
Another comes over, flippers shaking
We rest our heads together
Its call is thinner than mine

lines.zh: 我们挨着站，替对方挡风。
lines.en: We stand close, sheltering each other from the wind.
It goes first; I follow

lines.zh: 我们在雪上并排留下脚印
lines.en: We leave prints side by side
It nudges me with its beak
The two of us drop low
The wind's up; we press close
This is the right one
I take it in my beak
It's lighter than a fish
I shake it and it doesn't move
I set it on the snow
It drops into the ice crack
I test it underfoot
This can't be eaten
I push it along a stretch
This one's shiny; I like it
I carry it back toward the nest
Something's come onto the ice
I puff my chest and call

lines.zh: 我把鳍张开，挡在同伴前面。
lines.en: I spread my flippers in front of my mate.
I spread my flippers to look bigger
I keep my eyes fixed on it
The whole colony turns to look
I take two steps toward it
The ice is too slick for running
I'm calling very loudly
Then I'll just stand
I stand side-on, flippers out
I call, and others join
It moves and I back away
My feet slip once
I edge toward the ice hole
The water is my way out
I keep my eyes on it
I lower my head, beak forward
I'm not running; I'm waiting
One step closer and I'll charge
I peck at its leg
I beat my flippers and ram
That wasn't a heavy blow
I miss and nearly fall
It retreats and I fold my flippers
I hop and hit its knee
My beak knocks something hard
I call and peck together
That pushes it back half a step
I back off at once

lines.zh: 雪地上多了一个小身影
lines.en: A small shape appears on the snow
I waddle out from behind a drift

lines.zh: 我从雪堆里探出黑白脑袋。
lines.en: I poke my black-and-white head from the snowdrift.

lines.zh: 我这对白眼圈，天生就有。
lines.en: These white eye rings came with me.
The ice is slick; I find my feet
The wind flattens my feathers

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看着这片雪原
lines.en: I raise my head to this snowfield
I waddle over to you
The water isn't far

lines.zh: 我把小脑袋往你那边歪
lines.en: I tip my little head your way

lines.zh: 我被烫得跳起来，羽毛有焦味
lines.en: The burn makes me jump; my feathers smell scorched

lines.zh: 我从冰崖上掉下去，摔在雪里
lines.en: I fall off the ice cliff into the snow

lines.zh: 水灌进我嘴里，我蹬着往上游
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I kick upward

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀得滚了几圈
lines.en: The blast rolls me over and over
An arrow goes through my wing
That force makes my head swim

lines.zh: 很久没吃到鱼，我肚子空了
lines.en: No fish in so long; my belly is empty

lines.zh: 雷打在冰上，我整只弹起来
lines.en: Lightning hits the ice and I leap up

lines.zh: 下面没有冰，我踩不到东西
lines.en: No ice below; my feet find nothing
